Name: Sexy Witch
Author: ApryllForever
Description:
Meet Fianna, Servant of the Goddess Aine! She blesses your chicken coop with void eggs, or makes all your slimes in your slime hutch black! (The in-game event has a 1% chance of occurring. To increase your chances of this occurring, download and use Aedenthorn's Mod, [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/10633]Night Event Chance Tweak[/url].

Default mode for this mod is NSFW; there is, however, a configuration to make it SFW. Open the config in the mod folder, and change it from "true" to "false".


[size=5]Install
[/size]
[list=1]
[*][url=https://smapi.io]Install the latest version of SMAPI[/url].
[*]Download this mod and unzip it into [font=Courier New]Stardew Valley/Mods[/font].
[*]Run the game using SMAPI.
[/list]

[size=5]How to use
[/size]
Unzip and add to your mod folder!

[size=5]Compatibility
[/size]
[list]
[*]Works with Stardew Valley 1.5.6 on Linux/macOS/Windows.
[*]Works in single player, multiplayer, and split-screen mode. All must have the mod installed though for it to work.
[*]Not compatible with any other  mod which edits the witch sprite.
[/list]
